name: Event
description: API for creating event dispatchers, binding listeners to those dispatchers,
and dispatching events to those bound listeners.
It's safe to expose this API to addons, but you should avoid exposing the dispatcher objects themselves.
The dispatcher is a regular table containing all bound event listeners,
and while the structure of that table (i.e. the supported events) is immutable,
the individual lists of callbacks for each event are not!
Instead, you should create wrappers for adding and removing listeners. For example:

functions.name: createDispatcher
description: Creates a new dispatcher with the given supported events.
Calling any of the functions taking a dispatcher and event name will raise an error
if the given event is not in this list.

functions.name: dispatch
functions.description: Dispatch the given event to all listeners bound to it.

parameters.name: dispatcher
parameters.description: Dispatcher to trigger the event on.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: Event to dispatch. Must be supported by the dispatcher.
Any additional arguments to pass to the listeners.

functions.name: addListener
functions.description: Bind a callback to listen to a dispatcher's event.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: Event to listen to. Must be supported by the dispatcher.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Called when the event is fired with arguments passed by `Event.dispatch`.

returns.name: callback
returns.description: Callback function that was passed in (for convenience to remove the listener later)

functions.name: removeListener
functions.description: Remove a callback that was bound to a dispatcher's event.

parameters.name: dispatcher
parameters.description: Dispatcher to remove the listener from.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: Event to remove the listener from. Must be supported by the dispatcher.

classes.name: Dispatcher
description: Table containing all event listeners bound to the dispatcher.
Note that the dispatcher itself is immutable, however the lists of callbacks on each event name are not.

properties.name: listeners
properties.description: Arrays of callbacks keyed off of the event names supported by the dispatcher.
